faqs.q: What is the character limit for Free Fire nicknames?
faqs.a: Free Fire player nicknames have a strict 12-character limit, while Pet nicknames have an 8-character limit. Our tool features live validation counters for both.

faqs.q: How can I add an invisible space to my Free Fire name?
faqs.a: Standard spacebars fail in Free Fire. Use our Add FF Space button to insert Unicode Hangul Filler (U+3164) or Braille blank (U+2800) for seamless clan tag spacing.

faqs.q: Can I copy the golden V-Badge into my Free Fire bio?
faqs.a: Yes! Use our Bio & Signature Color Builder to copy [b][c][FFFF00]Ⓥ directly into your Free Fire profile signature.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to change a nickname in Free Fire?
faqs.a: Changing your nickname in Free Fire costs 390 Diamonds or 1 Name Change Card. Our character safety checker ensures you do not waste currency on truncated names.
